Admissions FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions About NIIB

Get answers to common questions before choosing a beauty course in Lucknow.

What courses are available at NIIB Lucknow?

You can enquire about professional makeup artistry, hairstyling, nail technician, cosmetology, beauty and skin artistry, spa therapy and other programs listed above. Please confirm the current batches with the admissions team.

Can I join NIIB if I am a complete beginner?

You can enquire as a beginner. Entry requirements depend on the individual course. The NIIB admissions team can help you understand the eligibility and choose a suitable starting point.

How can I check course fees and the next batch date?

Fees, duration and upcoming batch dates depend on the course. Call +91 9278114526 or request a course counselling session for the latest details.

Does NIIB offer practical classes?

NIIB describes its courses as practice-focused. Ask the counsellor for the course-specific practical syllabus, equipment, class format and training schedule before enrolling.

What certificate will I receive after training?

The certificate and issuing organization depend on the course. Please request the exact course certificate details and recognition information before admission.

Can NIIB help me understand career options after a course?

You can ask the NIIB team about career guidance and any current placement support. Individual employment, income and placement outcomes are not guaranteed.

Can I visit the NIIB campus before admission?

Yes, you can request a campus visit. NIIB is listed in Hazratganj, Lucknow. Call the admissions team for directions and to confirm a suitable visiting time.

How do I contact NIIB admissions?

Call +91 9278114526 or use the WhatsApp button to ask about courses, admissions, fees and campus visits.
